generations.zh: 2026-11-05 发布、11-12 开放权重。594B 总参 / 17B 激活，384 专家 / 8 激活，48 层，1M 上下文，文本 + 图像输入，Apache-2.0；AA Intelligence Index 31。
generations.en: Released 2026-11-05 with weights opened on 11-12. 594B total / 17B active, 384 experts with 8 active, 48 layers, 1M context, text + image input, Apache-2.0; AA Intelligence Index 31.

generations.zh: 2026-11-20 发布。26.4B 总参 / 3.4B 每 token 激活（循环层后约 5.4B 有效），24 层 looped MoE，1M 上下文，Apache-2.0；Unsloth 已给出 7.76–22.87GB GGUF。
generations.en: Released 2026-11-20. 26.4B total / 3.4B active per token (about 5.4B effective after looping), 24-layer looped MoE, 1M context, Apache-2.0; Unsloth ships 7.76–22.87GB GGUF files.

sizeTiers.zh: 旗舰 594B-A17B：Inkling 2 Small，多模态，1M 上下文；MXFP8 版需约 800GB 聚合显存，不是单机本地档。
sizeTiers.en: Flagship 594B-A17B: Inkling 2 Small, multimodal, 1M context; the MXFP8 checkpoint needs about 800GB of aggregate VRAM, not a single-machine local tier.

sizeTiers.zh: 本地 26.4B-A3.4B：Inkling 2 Mini，24 层循环 MoE，Q4_K_M 16.61GB，24GB 级显卡可跑短中上下文。
sizeTiers.en: Local 26.4B-A3.4B: Inkling 2 Mini, 24-layer looped MoE, Q4_K_M at 16.61GB, runnable on 24GB-class cards at short-to-medium context.

licenses.zh: Apache-2.0（两个模型权重同许可；另附 acceptable use policy）
licenses.en: Apache-2.0 for both checkpoints, with an additional acceptable use policy

claims.zh: 官方模型卡：Inkling 2 Small 为 594B 总参、17B 激活，48 层 decoder-only，384 专家中每 token 激活 8 个，支持 1M token 上下文与文本 + 图像输入。
claims.en: Official model card: Inkling 2 Small has 594B total parameters, 17B active, a 48-layer decoder-only transformer routing each token to 8 of 384 experts, 1M-token context and text + image input.

claims.zh: 官方模型卡：MXFP8 checkpoint 需要至少 800GB 聚合显存的 GPU 集群；NVFP4 是另一个更小的 checkpoint。
claims.en: Official model card: the MXFP8 checkpoint requires a GPU cluster with at least 800GB of aggregate VRAM; NVFP4 is a separate, smaller checkpoint.

claims.zh: 官方发布页：Inkling 2 Small 在 AA Intelligence Index 得 31 分，权重于 2026-11-12 在 Hugging Face 以 Apache-2.0 开放。
claims.en: Official release page: Inkling 2 Small scores 31 on the AA Intelligence Index; weights opened on Hugging Face under Apache-2.0 on 2026-11-12.

claims.zh: 官方模型卡：Inkling 2 Mini 为 26.4B 总参 / 3.4B 激活，24 层 decoder-only，6–17 层循环 3 次，1M 上下文与文本 + 图像输入。
claims.en: Official model card: Inkling 2 Mini has 26.4B total / 3.4B active parameters, a 24-layer decoder-only stack with layers 6–17 looped three times, 1M context and text + image input.

positioning.zh: 同一代的两条线：Small 是 594B 级旗舰，用来打前沿 Agent / 多模态任务；Mini 是 26B 级本地节点，用循环层换容量。两者都是 Apache-2.0、1M 上下文，但硬件门槛相差一个数量级，不能互相替代。
positioning.en: Two lines in the same generation: Small is the 594B-class flagship for frontier agent and multimodal work; Mini is the 26B-class local node that trades repeated layers for capacity. Both are Apache-2.0 with 1M context, but their hardware floors differ by an order of magnitude and they do not replace each other.

onSite.zh: 这里没有单独的量化系列页：Mini 的 GGUF 档位写进 2026 增补卡，Small 的官方 NVFP4 / MXFP8 权重只作规格记录。
onSite.en: No separate quantisation series page: Mini's GGUF tiers are recorded in the 2026 patch card, while Small's official NVFP4 / MXFP8 checkpoints are recorded as specs only.
